rollback.procedure: 1) Redeploy previous git commit / deployment_version. 2) Keep DATABASE_URL pointing at compatible schema (migrations append-only; do not DROP history tables). 3) Pin previous prompts via published KB release or prior yaml-{digest} pin. 4) Do not UPDATE/DELETE append-only fact_history / claim_plans / draft_versions (triggers block). 5) Verify /health commit + kb_release match the prior freeze.
